20261118-physics-g11.title: Force na mouvement na relativité

20261118-physics-g11.material: [H2 Gingo ti Fiziki] Kpale so asara kusala na a-ndia ti Force na mouvement na relativité. Na ndo ti sese so akpe nzoni, ngangu $F = 10\text{ N}$ asara kusala na ndo ti ye $m = 2\text{ kg}$ na yongoro ti $4\text{ m}$. Tene wa afa kusala $W$ na gbe ti loro $a$ nzoni?
20261118-physics-g11.thinking.1: Bibe ti ndara na gingo nda ti ye
20261118-physics-g11.s.s1.prompt: [H2 Gingo ti Fiziki] Kpale so asara kusala na a-ndia ti Force na mouvement na relativité. Na ndo ti sese so akpe nzoni, ngangu $F = 10\text{ N}$ asara kusala na ndo ti ye $m = 2\text{ kg}$ na yongoro ti $4\text{ m}$. Tene wa afa kusala $W$ na gbe ti loro $a$ nzoni?
20261118-physics-g11.s.s1.explain:
Tamba 1: Na ndia use ti Newton $F = ma$, loro $a = \frac{F}{m} = \frac{10\text{ N}}{2\text{ kg}} = 5\text{ m/s}^2$.
Tamba 2: Kusala so asara ayeke $W = F \cdot s = 10\text{ N} \times 4\text{ m} = 40\text{ J}$.
Tamba 3: Tongaso loro ayeke $5\text{ m/s}^2$ na kusala ayeke $40\text{ J}$.
20261118-physics-g11.s.s1.hint.0: Ndia use ti Newton: sara kusala na $F = ma$.
20261118-physics-g11.s.s1.hint.1: Nda ti kusala: sara kusala na $W = F \times s$.

20261121-physics-g11-1.title: Force na mouvement na relativité
20261121-physics-g11-1.goal: Sara kusala na a-ndia ti Force na mouvement na relativité ti leke kpale ni.
20261121-physics-g11-1.material: [H2 Gingo ti Fiziki (Ti kota)] Fango yâ ti tongo ti ye senge senge na ndo ti Force na mouvement na relativité. Mbeni ye atï londo na dutingo kpô na ya ti pupu na gbe ti ngangu ti sese $g = 9.8\text{ m/s}^2$. Loro $v$ na yongoro $h$ ayeke nye na peko ti $t = 3\text{ s}$?
20261121-physics-g11-1.thinking.1: Bibe ti ndara na gingo nda ti ye
20261121-physics-g11-1.s.s1.prompt: [H2 Gingo ti Fiziki (Ti kota)] Fango yâ ti tongo ti ye senge senge na ndo ti Force na mouvement na relativité. Mbeni ye atï londo na dutingo kpô na ya ti pupu na gbe ti ngangu ti sese $g = 9.8\text{ m/s}^2$. Loro $v$ na yongoro $h$ ayeke nye na peko ti $t = 3\text{ s}$?
20261121-physics-g11-1.s.s1.explain:
Tamba 1: Loro $v = gt = 9.8 \times 3 = 29.4\text{ m/s}$.
Tamba 2: Yongoro $h = \frac{1}{2}gt^2 = 0.5 \times 9.8 \times 9 = 44.1\text{ m}$.
Tamba 3: Tongaso $v = 29.4\text{ m/s}$ na $h = 44.1\text{ m}$.
20261121-physics-g11-1.s.s1.hint.0: Loro ti tongo ti ye: $v = gt$.
